properties.name: PublishSingleFile
properties.doc: Publish the application as one executable.

properties.name: IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract
properties.doc: Put the native libraries into the single file too; they are extracted on start.

properties.name: IncludeAllContentForSelfExtract
properties.doc: Put every file into the single file and extract them on start.

properties.name: EnableCompressionInSingleFile
properties.doc: Compress the assemblies inside the single file: smaller, slower start.

properties.name: PublishTrimmed
properties.doc: Remove the unused code from a self-contained application.

properties.name: TrimMode
properties.doc: Trim every assembly, or only the ones that opted in.

properties.name: PublishAot
properties.doc: Compile to native code ahead of time: no JIT, fast start, no runtime code generation.

properties.name: PublishReadyToRun
properties.doc: Precompile the assemblies: faster start, bigger files, the JIT is still there.

properties.name: PublishReadyToRunComposite
properties.doc: One composite ReadyToRun image for the framework and the application.

properties.name: IsAotCompatible
properties.doc: The library is AOT-compatible: turns on the trim, single-file and AOT analyzers.

properties.name: IsTrimmable
properties.doc: The library can be trimmed: turns on the trim analyzer.

properties.name: EnableTrimAnalyzer
properties.doc: Warn about code that is not safe to trim.

properties.name: EnableSingleFileAnalyzer
properties.doc: Warn about APIs that do not work in a single file (Assembly.Location).

properties.name: EnableAotAnalyzer
properties.doc: Warn about code that does not work under native AOT.

properties.name: SuppressTrimAnalysisWarnings
properties.doc: Hide the trim warnings.

properties.name: TrimmerSingleWarn
properties.doc: One warning per assembly instead of one per call site.

properties.name: OptimizationPreference
properties.doc: What native AOT optimizes for.

properties.name: StripSymbols
properties.doc: Keep the debug symbols of a native AOT executable in a separate file.

properties.name: DebuggerSupport
properties.doc: false: trim what only a debugger needs.

properties.name: EventSourceSupport
properties.doc: false: trim EventSource.

properties.name: UseSystemResourceKeys
properties.doc: Trim the exception messages of the framework; resource keys are shown instead.

properties.name: JsonSerializerIsReflectionEnabledByDefault
properties.doc: false: System.Text.Json works with source-generated contexts only.

properties.name: PublishDir
properties.doc: Where dotnet publish puts the application.

properties.name: PublishProfile
properties.doc: A .pubxml of Properties/PublishProfiles to publish with.

properties.name: PublishRelease
properties.doc: dotnet publish uses the Release configuration (the default since SDK 8).

properties.name: PackRelease
properties.doc: dotnet pack uses the Release configuration (the default since SDK 8).
